entries.title: Proverbs 13:1
segments: ¶A wise son is a lover of teaching, but the ears of the haters of authority are shut to sharp words.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:2
segments: ¶A man will get good from the fruit of his lips, but the desire of the false is for violent acts.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:3
segments: ¶He who keeps a watch on his mouth keeps his life; but he whose lips are open wide will have destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:4
segments: ¶The hater of work does not get his desires, but the soul of the hard workers will be made fat.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:5
segments: ¶The upright man is a hater of false words: the evil-doer gets a bad name and is put to shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:6
segments: ¶Righteousness keeps safe him whose way is without error, but evil-doers are overturned by sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:7
segments: ¶A man may be acting as if he had wealth, but have nothing; another may seem poor, but have great wealth.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:8
segments: ¶A man will give his wealth in exchange for his life; but the poor will not give ear to sharp words.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:9
segments: ¶There is a glad dawn for the upright man, but the light of the sinner will be put out.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:10
segments: ¶The only effect of pride is fighting; but wisdom is with the quiet in spirit.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:11
segments: ¶Wealth quickly got will become less; but he who gets a store by the work of his hands will have it increased.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:12
segments: ¶Hope put off is a weariness to the heart; but when what is desired comes, it is a tree of life.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:13
segments: ¶He who makes sport of the word will come to destruction, but the respecter of the law will be rewarded.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:14
segments: ¶The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning men away from the nets of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:15
segments: ¶Wise behaviour gets approval, but the way of the false is their destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:16
segments: ¶A sharp man does everything with knowledge, but a foolish man makes clear his foolish thoughts.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:17
segments: ¶A man taking false news is a cause of trouble, but he who gives news rightly makes things well.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:18
segments: ¶Need and shame will be the fate of him who is uncontrolled by training; but he who takes note of teaching will be honoured.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:19
segments: ¶To get one's desire is sweet to the soul, but to give up evil is disgusting to the foolish.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:20
segments: ¶Go with wise men and be wise: but he who keeps company with the foolish will be broken.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:21
segments: ¶Evil will overtake sinners, but the upright will be rewarded with good.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:22
segments: ¶The heritage of the good man is handed down to his children's children; and the wealth of the sinner is stored up for the upright man.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:23
segments: ¶There is much food in the ploughed land of the poor; but it is taken away by wrongdoing.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:24
segments: ¶He who keeps back his rod is unkind to his son: the loving father gives punishment with care.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:25
segments: ¶The upright man has food to the full measure of his desire, but there will be no food for the stomach of evil-doers.
